payload.text: hv's rulings of 2026-11-17, given to vc in the live channel (vc's window; the first as a typed question, the rest as answers to vc's question dialog, read at 05:58Z by vc's date -u), in hv's wording, recorded by vc as mediator. (1) On Claude Usage, after the live repair found the fork's build naming accounts wrongly: "What's the current correct mainline release? I want to use that, not my fork." hv installed mainline 1.18 (richhickson/claudecodeusage, notarized) in /Applications by hv's own hand, in place of 1.15 and the fork's test build. (2) On who builds ISSUE:0008's items 6 and 7: "I've started all ccusage Claudes now. Use whatever you need to get this done. I want this fixed and shipped now first thing. I will also start devbin-vc, too." (3) On the launch-time fix, chosen from vc's options: "Drop it". (4) On Claude Usage naming each Keychain item once per run and keeping its history per item: "No, file the PR on "Claude Usage" now. I want this all done and dusted right now. And let me review the PR text before you submit it to Claude Usage. I want it simple, succinct, bullets and short sentences in basic ASD-STE100 form. Ok?" vc's reading: the next cut, 0.1.10, carries ISSUE:0008 whole (items 1 to 7 and cc's check of the incoming login), ISSUE:0009 and ic's Herdr fix, and ships first thing, with every seat at work; the launch-time question is closed; the Claude Usage fix goes upstream now as a PR from hv's fork, built by ic, and nothing is pushed or opened until hv has read its text.
